text:
jia: FYI seeing a weird reconnect loop from a handful of clients on prod this morning. Happens when the server emits super small WS frames (~10-30 bytes). Clients drop connection, then immediately reconnect and double-bill. Repro steps and logs below.

sam: which route/version? any recent proxy changes?

jia: route: /v1/stream/gen (eu-west). model: rwd-7b-v1. No app code changes on the client side. Seems correlated with the edge-proxy canary we rolled last night.

carla: I remember a similar symptom — proxy coalescing + nginx tcp_nodelay toggles can turn tiny frames into a sequence that the client library treats as EOF. Do you have a raw hex dump?

jia: yep. raw fragment from the proxy logs: 

```
FRAME: 0x1b 0x22 0x7b 0x22 0x69 0x64 0x22 0x3a 0x22 0x31 0x22 0x7d
(totally small, looks like: "{\"id\":\"1\"}")
```

client log: `ws.onclose: code=1006, reason=""` then `reconnect()` immediately.

mike: do we have any telemetry split by frame size currently? console only shows per-request tokens/latency.

leo: not by default. We can add `stream.frame_size_histogram` label per route. Quick win: tag frames < 64 bytes as `small_frame=true` so ops can filter.

carla: quick hypothesis: edge-proxy is chopping events into micro-frames and the browser ws lib treats a tiny non-utf8 chunk as connection termination. Might be the proxy's `proxy_buffering` or http2->ws translation.

sam: can we reproduce locally? Jia, can you share a minimal repro snippet?

jia: pasted a minimal Node repro: 

```
const WebSocket = require('ws');
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://edge.staging.redwood.ai/v1/stream/gen');
ws.on('message', (m) => console.log('msg len', m.length, m));
// server-side: send(Buffer.from('{"id":"1"}')) repeatedly
```

If we run through the edge proxy we see the 10-30 byte behaviour; bypassing the proxy (direct to runtime) doesn't reproduce.

mike: sounds like proxy change then. Can we hotfix the proxy to coalesce tiny writes server->client into single frame? Might be safer than dropping tiny frames.

carla: agree coalescing is better than dropping. But watch out: heartbeats are small by design. We need to detect semantic heartbeats vs actual payload. Options:
- coalesce consecutive small frames within 50ms into one payload
- if small frame is valid JSON/utf8 -> pass through, else buffer up to timeout

sam: concern: coalescing might add 10-20ms latency to tail tokens. But better than reconnects for customers. We should gate the change behind a rollout flag and make it configurable per route.

leo: I'll add metrics and a console flag: `edge.coalesce_small_frames` with per-route override. Also add `stream.small_frame_count` and `stream.coalesce_latency_ms` for the rollout dashboard.

deploy-bot: canary: edge-proxy/staging -> deployed at 2026-03-23T09:12:00Z (canary id c-987).

carla: opened PR: https://git.redwood.ai/carla/edge-proxy-coalesce-small-frames (WIP). Implemented heuristic: buffer up to 64 bytes or 50ms, whichever comes first. Unit tests + integration with websocket emulator included.

mike: priority: P2 for now but escalate to P1 if more tenants report billing dups. Also add incident playbook note about reconnect-induced duplicated tokens for streaming routes.

jia: I'm going to run the staging canary against the failing client set. Will post logs here in ~30m. Assigning follow-ups: @carla to finish PR, @leo to add metrics and dashboard, @sam to schedule rollout guardrails.

sam: sgtm. Also suggestion for console: on route page add a small panel "stream anomalies" that surfaces tiny-frame spikes and reconnect loops per timeframe. That will save ops pinging infra.

leo: will prototype a 2x2 panel (count of tiny frames, reconnect rate, median coalesce latency, impacted tenant ids).

carla: FYI the PR includes a CLI flag to force-disable coalescing per-host: `edge-proxy --coalesce-small-frames=false` for quick rollback.

jia: test run in staging shows reconnects dropped from ~18/min to ~1/min for the test clients. Leaving canary running for 2h before broader rollout. Will update after 120m. :eyes:

mike: thanks team. If staging stays green let's plan a slow 10% -> 50% -> 100% rollout with console guardrails.

carla: adding a short blurb in release notes: "Mitigation for tiny-frame reconnect loops in streaming paths (edge proxy coalescing heuristic)."

jia: posted follow-up logs: staging reduction confirmed. attaching stack snippets in case we need to roll back.

sam: great. once dashboards are live ping #incidents and #product-ops before 50% step.

deploy-bot: rollout plan scheduled: 10% @ 2026-03-23T12:00Z -> 50% @ 2026-03-23T13:00Z -> 100% @ 2026-03-23T14:30Z (manual hold between steps).

carla: PR -> merged to canary branch, creating cherry for stable after we validate.

jia: thanks everyone. I'll update thread if anything flares. :thumbsup:
